claims.claim_text: The protected identifier printed for indexed Private Raymond W. McDonald conflicts with the official Army bulk entry attached to that identifier.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official Army entry carries a severely corrupted or conflicting name; the number and conflicting name are withheld from public output.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting: protected-identifier agreement cannot overcome the unusable name conflict, so the Army identity is not assigned to McDonald.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflict concerns identity resolution only and supplies no reliable pre-OSS employer or affiliation chronology.
claims.match_notes: Review the original Box 503 file and adjacent index documentation before making identity or employment claims. The contextless newspaper candidate was also rejected.

claims.claim_text: The protected identifier printed for indexed Private Roy W. McDonald conflicts with the official Army bulk entry attached to that identifier.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The official Army entry assigns the same protected identifier to a wholly different name; the number and other person's name are withheld from public output.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting: protected-identifier agreement is outweighed by complete name disagreement; the Army identity must not be assigned to McDonald.
claims.temporal_assessment: The conflict concerns identity resolution only and supplies no reliable pre-OSS employer or affiliation chronology.
claims.match_notes: A same-name institutional employment lead lacks any bridge to the indexed private and is not published as an affiliation. Review Box 503.
